title: Great device, I don't know how I lived without it all these years!
text: Great device, I don't know how I lived without it all these years!. This is a neat little device. I used to use my garlic press, but no more. This helps me grate garlic into smaller slivers which seems to blend and cook better in my recipes. The most wonderful part of all is the cleanup. My garlic press seemed to leave more in the device than in my recipes and clean up was difficult getting it out of all the nooks and crannies. This garlic grater works cleaner and I get far more garlic in my dishes. I also like that I can slide or shred into different consistencies (depending on my recipe), something I would usually have to do with a knife. I couldn't be happier with this device and no kitchen should be without it. This would make a great little add on bridal shower gift (something unique and useful).

description: Fantes Cousin Umberto's Garlic Press crushes garlic easily in just seconds, with or without removing the skin. A helpful addition to food preparation and cooking tools, it’s easy to add depths of flavor to favorite dishes. Simply place a clove of garlic inside, close the handle and squeeze with both hands. With or without peeling garlic skins, Cousin Umberto's Garlic Press tackles garlic effortlessly. Cleaning tool included to quickly dislodge stubborn food bits for easier cleanup. Made from heavyweight aluminum for strength and durability. Hand wash in warm, soapy water. Fante’s, The Italian Market Original since 1906. Brought to you by HIC Harold Import Co.
